scope: Only the three prespecified already-viewed cases; read completed shared API text, no new API/model call or cache changes.

cases.caption: A plastic ruler is bent until it cracks, displaying a visible stress fracture that propagates.
relations: Hands gripping the strip's ends apply opposing forces that bend it toward its center.
Increasing bend strain concentrates stress at the strip's midsection, initiating a crack.
The stress fracture propagates along the transparent strip, splitting it into two pieces.
cases.provided: 关系句已明确弯曲应变、裂纹产生和传播；关键请求内容在输入文字中存在。
cases.extra_assumptions: 首帧/请求未要求必然从正中裂开并最终断成两片；这是额外的具体展开。
cases.output_gap: 实际视频呈现大范围片状拉伸而非清楚的裂纹传播，不能只用缺少文字解释。

cases.caption: A person bounces to a specific rhythm on a trampoline, their body movement clearly timed to a beat.
relations: The trampoline mat depresses under the person then recoils upward, propelling them back into the air.
The person's limbs extend during the upward phase and tuck during the downward phase, synced to a steady beat.
Each bounce height and timing repeats consistently, matching the rhythm without drifting off-beat.
cases.provided: 关系句包含床面下压/回弹以及节奏性跳跃，视频有动作恢复。
cases.extra_assumptions: 上升时伸肢、下降时收腿和每次等高并非由原请求必然规定的动作模式。
cases.output_gap: 本例反而有可见改善，尚无证据这些额外细节造成失败；不要把可能的未来选择一律判为物理错误。

cases.caption: A person mops up a puddle of water on a concrete floor, the water disappearing as the mop passes.
relations: As the mop head sweeps across the puddle, displaced water is absorbed into the bristles, reducing the visible wet area.
The concrete floor beneath the mop's path transitions from reflective wetness to matte dryness as the bristles pass.
Remaining puddle edges recede inward as the mop removes water from the center outward.
The mop handle tilts and translates with the sweeping motion, maintaining bristle contact with the floor surface.
cases.provided: 关系句包含拖把经过时吸水、可见湿区缩小、保持地面接触。
cases.extra_assumptions: 从中心向外去水和立即由反光湿润变为哑光干燥，是超出原请求的确定性细节。
cases.output_gap: 视频只明确出现拖把运动及水的重新分布，未清楚体现逐次去水，关键条件尚未充分执行。

conclusion: 关键请求/物理变化信息已有部分正确表述，输出仍会失败。现有证据只能将问题定位到生成条件的利用/执行链仍有缺口，不能在Q提取、C表示、融合或Wan能力之间确定唯一根因。同数据R10A与branch-off/text-only/正常空无关等配对将继续区分。额外确定性细节属于后续输入质量改进候选，不据三例认定它是主要因果。
